title: جشن فانوس‌های عددی
logline_fa: هر فانوس یک عدد است؛ فانوس‌ها یکی‌یکی روشن می‌شوند و بالا می‌روند، کوچک‌ها زیاد و بزرگ‌ها کم، تا جمع همه آسمان را پر کند و یک عدد بزرگ بماند.

protagonist.what: a paper lantern that carries a Persian number
protagonist.build: SVG rounded rect + inner glow circle + text; 30 instances, size proportional to the value (real scale), seeded positions
protagonist.state_change: dark empty sky -> lanterns lit one by one -> sky full -> total number counted at the top

beats.what: night sky, one lantern lights with the number ۱
lanterns light in groups, sizes grow with value, counter climbs
all fly up together; total counts to the final number
total stamps in the sky; copy

payoffs.viewer_gets: sky is dark, one warm glow
lights appear on the grid beat, sizes by number
the number slams in and everything flashes warm

assets: SVG lanterns generated, stars, seeded layout; fictional numbers only
kit sfx: match, pluck, bell, boom

tests: many instances (30) within the DOM budget
likely_skill_gaps: no counter/odometer in lib (only inline in pencil)
acceptance: run-gates number-lint clean, totals add up
lantern sizes proportional to values within 2%
